title: Witch Unicorn at Twilight
description: A vibrant purple unicorn with a witch hat, long flowing mane adorned with beads and tassels, and a skeletal lower leg stands rearing in a misty green field. It is surrounded by swirling purple fog, glowing mushrooms, a broken wooden fence, twisted trees with a silhouetted witch, and a large red moon in the cloudy night sky.
prompt: A mystical purple unicorn wearing a pointed witch hat stands in a misty meadow at night, its mane filled with colorful beads and tassels, one front leg skeletal. Twisted gnarled trees, glowing mushrooms, broken wooden fences, and a flying witch silhouette surround it under a large blood-red full moon in a cloudy sky, vibrant fantasy style with swirling purple mist.
